description: Election Commission - Mrs. S. A. Sujeewa of the Thissamaharama Pradesiya Sbaha has Vacated her Office of member of that P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local authority (Thissamaharama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls under electoral processes and local government elections matters, specifically addressing the status of elected members and vacancies in local authorities, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
